annotations.title: French condominium syndic and mandate end (by registry number)

description: Use this when you need to know who manages a French condominium (its professional syndic) and when that syndic's mandate ends. For 1 to 50 condominiums (registry number, e.g. AA2002871): the syndic with SIRET, the declared end of its mandate (3 years max, art. 28 decree 67-223), days left, status, lots, address, from the official ANAH registry (656,000 condos, daily file). For syndics, insurers, building contractors. Price: 0.01 USDC per call (x402). Free trial: set free_trial to true (3 calls per day per caller).

free_trial.description: Set to true to ask for the free trial (3 calls per day per caller, shared with the web route, within a daily cap for the service). Without it, the tool asks for an x402 payment.

name: syndic_lookup

licence.description: Licence of the source data: nom, url, source, attribution (the credit the licence requires)

duree_declaree_suspecte.description: End date more than 3 years (and a month) after the record's last update: a suspicion, not proof of an irregularity

jours_avant_fin_mandat.description: Days until the declared end date, 0 on that day, null once passed

jours_depuis_fin_mandat.description: Days since the declared end date, null until it has passed

statut.description: Reading of the record at date_calcul; echeance_dans_90_jours covers day 0 to day 90 included

type_syndic.description: professionnel, bénévole (cooperative syndicates included, as in the registry), or non déclaré
